title: Vertex AI Claude gateway requests: anthropic_version and model-stripping live on _VertexAIClaudeAdapter, not the provider hook
answers: Why do mlflow.genai judges on vertex_ai:/claude-* fail with 'anthropic_version: Field required' and a SCORER_ERROR with an empty judge column?
How does a Claude model on Vertex AI get its request body formatted when called through the gateway adapter instead of the chat endpoint?
Where is the anthropic_version field added for Claude partner models on Vertex AI?
Which code removes the model field from the body for Vertex Claude requests?
body:
Path: `mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_VertexAIClaudeProvider` serves Claude models on Vertex AI (`vertex_ai:/claude-*`), including chat and streaming requests and the judge path that formats via `adapter_class` (`GatewayAdapter._invoke_and_handle_tools` in `mlflow.genai.judges.adapters.gateway_adapter`).
Rule: Vertex-required Anthropic fields (`anthropic_version` set, `model` removed from the body) are applied in `_VertexAIClaudeAdapter.chat_to_model` via the shared classmethod `_VertexAIClaudeAdapter._apply_vertex_fields`. `_VertexAIClaudeProvider.adapter_class` returns this adapter, and `_VertexAIClaudeProvider._prepare_payload` reuses `_apply_vertex_fields` for the `_chat`/`_chat_stream` path. Keep the transformation on the adapter so any caller that formats via `adapter_class` gets a valid payload.
Symptom: Every Claude-on-Vertex judge call was rejected with `anthropic_version: Field required`. The failure surfaced as a `SCORER_ERROR` with `value=None`, so `mlflow.genai.evaluate()` finished and rendered a table with an empty judge column.
Constraints: Applies to Claude models on Vertex AI only. Bedrock already does the equivalent in its own adapter (`AmazonBedrockAnthropicAdapter.chat_to_model`). Gemini and MaaS/OpenAI-compatible Vertex models use different adapters and are not affected by this change.
applies: Vertex AI Claude (`vertex_ai:/claude-*`) request formatting in the gateway and in judges that use it.
says: Evaluation metrics table displays blank judge columns when evaluating with Claude on Vertex.
Generative AI evaluation fails with a scoring error when using Vertex Claude models.
Claude judge evaluations on Vertex AI return empty score cards in the dashboard.
Fix evaluation runs failing silently with missing judge scores on Vertex Claude endpoints.
Model evaluation results show empty columns instead of scores for Claude judges.
search: Vertex AI Claude requests (vertex_ai:/claude-*) format payloads by setting anthropic_version and removing the model field in _VertexAIClaudeAdapter.chat_to_model via _VertexAIClaudeAdapter._apply_vertex_fields so callers using adapter_class like mlflow.genai judges receive valid payloads. _VertexAIClaudeProvider.adapter_class returns this adapter and reuses _apply_vertex_fields in _prepare_payload for chat and streaming. This applies to Vertex AI Claude models and does not apply to Bedrock, Gemini, or MaaS/OpenAI-compatible Vertex models.
